# ALAR Chauffeur Service

> ALAR Chauffeur Service is a reserved chauffeur, airport car service, black car, limo, Sprinter, and group transportation company based in Edison, New Jersey. Primary coverage is the Tri-State area (New Jersey, New York, Connecticut, Pennsylvania) and Massachusetts, with additional service in California, Nevada, and Washington. Rates are confirmed before the ride. Flight tracking and meet-and-greet are available on airport transfers.

Public marketing pages may be summarized with attribution to ALAR Chauffeur Service and a link to the source URL. Summarize pages instead of reproducing them in full. Use logos and brand assets only with permission. Honor page-level noindex directives. Fetch large media on demand. Contact: limo@alarchauffeurservice.com. Desk: 10 Fairmount Ave, Edison, NJ 08820.

- [Service areas](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas): State coverage across the Tri-State area, Massachusetts, California, Nevada, and Washington.

- [Blog](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/blog): Airport and chauffeur booking guides.
- [Free quote](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/free-quote): Request a confirmed rate.

## Services

- [Airport transportation](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/airport-transportation): Private New Jersey airport transfers with flight tracking and meet-and-greet.
- [Corporate transportation](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/corporate-transportation): Executive car service for meetings, airports, and roadshows.
- [Wedding limo](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/wedding-limo): Wedding-day limo service in New Jersey.
- [Prom limo](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/prom-limo): Prom limo, stretch, and Sprinter service in New Jersey.
- [Sporting events](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/sporting-events): Game-day car service, including MetLife Stadium.
- [Group transportation](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/group-transportation): Private group travel in New Jersey.
- [Concert and festival](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/concert-festival): Event transportation for concerts and festivals.
- [Party bus](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/party-bus): Party bus rental in New Jersey.
- [Cruise port transfers](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/cruise-port-transfers): Cruise terminal transfers and packages.
- [Chauffeured service](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/chauffeured-service): Reserved private black car in New Jersey.
- [Hourly limo](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/services/hourly-limo): Hourly chauffeur service with a flexible schedule.

## Service areas

- [New Jersey](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/new-jersey): Edison, Jersey City, Short Hills, and Central Jersey, including JFK, LGA, and EWR.
- [New York](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/new-york): Manhattan and borough black car to JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark.
- [Connecticut](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/connecticut): Greenwich to Hartford, including Bradley (BDL) and NYC airports.
- [Pennsylvania](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/pennsylvania): Philadelphia and PHL, with links to Newark, JFK, and LGA.
- [Massachusetts](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/massachusetts): Greater Boston and Boston Logan (BOS).
- [California](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/california): San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles, including LAX.
- [Nevada](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/nevada): Las Vegas Strip and Harry Reid (LAS).
- [Washington](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/service-areas/washington): Seattle, Bellevue, and Sea-Tac (SEA).

## Airports

- [JFK](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/jfk): John F. Kennedy airport car service for New Jersey and New York.
- [LGA](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/lga): LaGuardia airport transfers.
- [EWR](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/ewr): Newark Liberty airport car service.
- [HPN](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/hpn): Westchester County Airport, White Plains.
- [TEB](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/teb): Teterboro private-aviation FBO pickup.
- [PHL](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/phl): Philadelphia International Airport.
- [BDL](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/bdl): Bradley International Airport, Hartford.
- [BOS](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/bos): Boston Logan International Airport.
- [LAX](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/lax): Los Angeles International Airport.
- [LAS](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/las): Harry Reid International Airport, Las Vegas.
- [SEA](https://alarchauffeurservice.com/airports/sea): Seattle-Tacoma International Airport.
